63_forced_degradations:
- **F-P04, F-P05, F-P06:** Originally reported as direct_verified by research subagent but downgraded to blocked_url_index_verified because full page was not directly fetched; snippets were recovered from Google search index results only.

64_exclusions_for_strict_name_test_failu:
Four self-positioning snippets from Payhip's own pages were excluded because "Payhip" was not explicitly named in the verbatim snippet text, per Rule 6:
- Pricing page heading "Simple pricing" (payhip.com/pricing)
- Alternatives page tagline "More Features • Better Support • Lower Fees" (payhip.com/payhip-alternatives)
- Vs-Gumroad pricing section beginning "Our goal is to make our pricing plans as simple and transparent as possible..." (payhip.com/payhip-vs-gumroad)
- Features page hero "We make it easy to sell digital downloads, courses, coaching, memberships and physical products" (payhip.com/features/sell-online)

One Trustpilot review (John Carter, payhip.com Trustpilot page 2) was excluded because the visible snippet referred to Payhip as "their" without naming "Payhip" explicitly.
65_truncated_trustpilot_review_text: Findings F-30 and F-31 capture Trustpilot reviews that are truncated on the page by "See more" display limits. The truncation is the platform's rendering, not researcher concatenation. The comparative positioning claim (competitor named alongside Payhip) is fully visible in the captured portion.
66_coverage_gaps:
- **Reddit (SD-11):** Zero findings. Multiple search strategies returned no indexed Reddit thread URLs with Payhip comparative statements. This is an indexing/accessibility limitation, not a confirmed absence of discussion. Noted as F-X04.
- **YouTube transcripts (SD-12):** No direct transcript access was achieved for any video. One video description was partially recovered via a third-party embed but failed Edge Case 3 validation. YouTube transcript tooling is a known limitation.
- **Capterra / Software Advice (SD-13 partial):** Capterra was reviewed but no individual user reviews contained explicit competitor-naming comparative statements alongside "Payhip" in visible text. Software Advice had an alternatives page but no accessible user reviews with comparative statements.
- **Payhip vs Etsy dedicated blog comparison (SD-09 partial):** No dedicated "Payhip vs Etsy" third-party comparison article was found. Etsy comparisons appear only within multi-platform listicles (F-22) and forum posts.
67_competitorauthored_source_note: Three findings (F-10, F-11, F-21) are from Sellfy's company blog. Sellfy is a direct competitor to both Payhip and Gumroad. One finding (F-P04) is from SchoolMaker, itself a course platform. One finding (F-P05) is from Fourthwall, a creator commerce platform. These are noted here for awareness but are not flagged in individual finding Notes fields, as the protocol restricts Notes to verification-related information only.
68_output_shape_deviation: The expected output shape was 5–10 clean, 5–10 provisional, 5–10 could not verify. Actual output is 31 clean, 7 provisional, 4 could not verify. The elevated clean count reflects thorough direct-fetch coverage of source pages. No findings were artificially created or inflated; the verification bar was not lowered. The low could-not-verify count reflects the Reddit and YouTube access gaps described above.
69_11point_qa_checklist_summary:
All 42 findings (31 clean + 7 provisional + 4 CNV) were checked against:
1. ✅ One finding = one source, one positioning statement
2. ✅ Multi-speaker pages split by speaker/account
3. ✅ What field fully supported by Verbatim snippet
4. ✅ Verbatim snippet is one continuous passage (no "..." concatenation by researcher; page-level truncation noted where applicable)
5. ✅ Source field is full URL (protocol + domain + path)
6. ✅ Payhip named explicitly in every snippet (5 exclusions applied for failures)
7. ✅ No synthesis in What field or findings
8. ✅ Verification tier conservative (5 forced degradations applied)
9. ✅ Edge cases applied correctly (Edge Case 3 for YouTube/Skool; Edge Case 4 not triggered)
10. ✅ source_type from closed list of 18 (review aggregators → unknown with note)
11. ✅ Notes field contains only permitted content (verification limits, fetch blocks, page undated, structured layout, multi-speaker splits, recovery method)
